import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, p;
        int c, w;
    }

    static class Graph {
        int n;
        List<Edge>[] g;

        public Graph(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            g = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        public void addEdge(int u, int v, int c, int w) {
            g[u].add(new Edge(v, g[v].size(), c, w));
            g[v].add(new Edge(u, g[u].size() - 1, 0, -w));
        }

        public boolean dijkstra(int s, int t) {
            int[] dis = new int[n];
            boolean[] vis = new boolean[n];
            PriorityQueue<int[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> a[0] - b[0]);
            q.add(new int[]{0, s});
            Arrays.fill(dis, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int[] poll = q.poll();
                int u = poll[1];
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                vis[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    int dv = poll[0] + e.w;
                    if (!e.c || vis[v] || dis[v] <= dv) continue;
                    q.add(new int[]{dis[v] = dv, v});
                }
            }
            return vis[t];
        }

        public boolean dinicBfs(int s, int t) {
            boolean[] vis = new boolean[n];
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            vis[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                    int v = e.v;
                    if (vis[v] || !e.c) continue;
                    if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w) continue;
                    vis[v] = vis[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
            return vis[t];
        }

        public int dinicDfs(int u, int t, int f) {
            if (u == t) return f;
            int sf = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge e = g[u].get(i);
                int v = e.v;
                if (!e.c || vis[v] != vis[u] + 1) continue;
                if (dis[v] != dis[u] + e.w) continue;
                int df = dinicDfs(v, t, Math.min(e.c, f));
                sf += df;
                f -= df;
                e.c -= df;
                g[v].get(e.p).c += df;
                if (!f) break;
            }
            return sf;
        }

        public Pair minCostFlow(int s, int t, int mf) {
            int sf = 0, sc = 0;
            int[] pot = new int[n];
            while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
                int f = 0;
                while (dinicBfs(s, t)) {
                    int[] cur = new int[n];
                    int df = dinicDfs(s, t, mf);
                    mf -= df;
                    f += df;
                    if (!mf) break;
                }
                sf += f;
                sc += (dis[t] + pot[t]) * f;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pot[i] += dis[i];
                if (!mf) break;
            }
            return new Pair(sf, sc);
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int l = Math.max(n, k) * 2;
        Graph g = new Graph(l * n);
        int s = g.addEdge(0, 1, 1, 0);
        int t = g.addEdge(0, 1, 1, 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            a--;
            g.addEdge(s, a, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int z = 1; z <= m; z++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i + 1 < l; i++) {
                int u1 = u + i * n;
                int v1 = v + (i + 1) * n;
                int u2 = u + (i + 1) * n;
                int v2 = v + i * n;
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    g.addEdge(u1, v1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    g.addEdge(v2, u2, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < l; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int u = j + i * n;
                int v = j + (i + 1) * n;
                g.addEdge(u, v, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < l; i++) {
            g.addEdge(i * n, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(g.minCostFlow(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE).second);
    }
}
